speaker: Patricio M. Giuffra
title: Trusting the Lord Through Tithes and Offerings
summary: Elder Giuffra teaches that tithing is a law of faith: paying it shows trust in the Lord, who keeps His promises in His own time and way. His main story is from his mission in Puerto Montt, Chile, where a poor woman of about 70 felt she could never pay tithing, and his mission president told him there were no exceptions; she prayed for help, was baptized, and paid her tithing and fast offering faithfully. He asks members to keep the commandments because they love God, to trust Him with their tithes and offerings, and to prove the Lord, who promises to open the windows of heaven.
